title: Implement the independent per-file uploader UI

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Uploader page tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_photo_upload_ui.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-001 RED: no photographer page preserves one independent visible result per selected file; GREEN: a real-browser flow selects one eligible СПА and authoritative visit_date, submits valid, invalid, undecodable, mixed-EXIF and duplicate files independently, preserves every completed row regardless of completion order and shows the matching accepted/rejected/duplicate outcome with persisted authoritative date; decisive comparison: visible rows, API observations and database date projection all match; artifact: Playwright CLI command transcript, browser trace/screenshots plus redacted integration output.
purpose: Complete the photographer-visible FT-001 outcome over the separately secured context and upload endpoints.
success_outcome: An authenticated photographer can select one СПА/date, upload multiple JPEGs without Batch confirmation and retain a truthful independent visible result for every completed file.
anti_goals: Do not implement processing-status progression, inventory administration, resumable upload, drag-and-drop framework or external ingest.
Do not move admission orchestration, authorization or storage access into browser code.

forbidden_scope: Photo delete/restore/purge UI owned by FT-012
Direct browser access to storage, database or internal services
stop_conditions: The page would require Batch, group confirmation or another accepted product change.
A file result cannot remain independent of other request completion order.
Real-browser proof cannot run in authorized isolated state or would require production data.

constraints: GET /staff/photo-upload requires an active photographer session and uses only same-origin application endpoints.
The page sends one independent request per file and keeps one visible row per file.
Use the installed Playwright CLI through `playwright cli` for real-browser proof; agent-browser, direct CDP, browser-free HTTP/DOM probes and a new product runtime are not substitutes.
invariants: Completion order never changes or removes another file result.
Mixed EXIF may warn but never rewrites or regroups the selected visit_date.
No Batch, manifest, aggregate confirmation or direct storage access appears in the UI.
verification_targets: Playwright CLI real-browser UAT covers valid, invalid, undecodable, mixed-EXIF, duplicate and deliberately reordered completion cases and stores the CLI transcript plus screenshots/traces under the task artifact directory.
